Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4289, GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

Needs changes before merge. SAFETY-tier review: this PR changes posted G-code.

**Requested before merge**

1. **P1 — Refuse the unsupported offset 255.** `assets/posts/mach3.cps:22` sets `workOffsetMax = 255`. [Using Mach3Mill, section 10.7.18](https://www.machsupport.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/02/Mach3Mill_1.84.pdf#page=128) specifies work offsets 1–254. With `PARAM WorkOffset 255`, this PR emits `G17 G90 G59 P255 G40 G80` without a warning. Bare main reports a refusal for the same input. The new test at `crates/post/tests/mach3_post.rs:132` requires this unsupported output. Class: controller-specific input bounds. Set the Mach3 maximum to 254. Use that bound for all offset acceptance and display names. Keep 254 as an accepted boundary. Require refusal for 255 and 256. Update the decision and PR body to state the same range. This must produce a diagnostic instead of unsupported G-code. The engine's generic `MAX_BOUND = 255` does not establish the Mach3 limit.

The command-specific section of [Using Mach3Mill, section 10.7.18](https://www.machsupport.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/02/Mach3Mill_1.84.pdf#page=128) specifies work offsets 1 through 254. The general overview has a conflicting count; the command section states the explicit range.

**Local results**

The trial merge used main `8937e684d0fe425dbc5c05213f74aa614be1e861` and PR head `a048f804732664d405e76a9893f0bf88c63debb2`. Its first parent is the PR head. The merge was clean. Main advanced during the review; these results name the tested base.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, with 8 jobs | PASS: 63 steps; 474 tests passed; 4 ignored; no failures |
| `mach3_post`, included in quick | PASS: 3 tests |
| `script_mach3`, included in quick | PASS: 11 golden cases |
| Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`), with 8 jobs | PASS: 6 steps; 11 tests; no failures |
| `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| Offset-255 safety probe, using `cargo run -p camcraft-post --bin post` | PR: no warning, emits `G59 P255`. Bare main: reports refusal. |

**Extra suites run**

- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 44 passed; 4 ignored.
- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.

These catalog suites ran in the quick gate. The diff changes no fixture, importer, or UI file. The additional importer suites and screenshots do not apply.

**Mutations**

The PR body contains no mutation record. I tested two independent mutations of copied CPS text in `/tmp`. Each used the post CLI and the new test's offset/output assertions.

- Restore `workOffsetMax = 6`: RED for the extended offsets. Original restored: GREEN.
- Emit `G59 P(n - 6)` for extended offsets: RED for the extended offsets. Original restored: GREEN.

Boundary probes also report diagnostics for 0, -1, 2.5, and 256. Offset 254 posts without a warning. Offset 255 exposes finding 1.

**Goldens moved**

None. No recorded `.nc`, `.cl`, catalog program, or golden file changed. The existing Mach3 golden cases pass unchanged.

The formatter uses the existing section preamble and operation notes. The tests cover standard and extended offset words. The upper-bound expectation needs correction.

`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` and `CLAUDE_JOB_DIR` are unset on this host. The session identity is `wopr pool job review-4289`; the authenticated login is `mkinney`.

I changed no PR code and used no GitHub runner. The worktree and branch remain for the next review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Clean review. No blocking findings. SAFETY-tier review: this PR changes posted G-code.

**Earlier finding**

1. **Fixed: refuse offset 255.** Commit `ea9a2134502896111662a2113d0dd7d15fdb98fd` sets the Mach3 maximum to 254. The formatter and display names use that bound. The regression test accepts 254 and requires diagnostics for 255 and 256. The decision record and PR body now state the same range. Local CLI probes confirm these results. This meets finding 1 of the [earlier review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4289#issuecomment-7209628446).

The range agrees with [Using Mach3Mill, section 10.7.18](https://www.machsupport.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/02/Mach3Mill_1.84.pdf#page=128). Standard offsets retain `G54` through `G59`. Extended offsets use their full index in `G59 P<n>`. Both the section preamble and operation note use this word.

**Local results**

The trial merge is `3a1fa9ea43a0ebeec0443b4d0513669fc38c6d42`. Its first parent is the reviewed PR head. Its second parent is main `9b141e1122fad4aca12e6502dd5f4963209b4e68`. The merge was clean. Main advanced to `b439de57961b706c9c953dbe0c4f19c828729908` during the review. The results below name the tested base. The current project laws and ownership guard have not changed.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, 8 jobs | PASS: 63 steps; 474 tests passed; 4 ignored; 0 failed |
| `mach3_post`, included in quick | PASS: 3 tests |
| `script_mach3`, included in quick | PASS: 11 golden cases |
| `cargo xtask gate light`, 8 jobs | PASS: 6 steps; 11 tests; 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |
| `cargo build -j 8 -p camcraft-post --bin post` | PASS |

**Extra suites run**

These suites ran in the quick gate:

- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 44 passed; 4 ignored.
- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.

The PR changes no fixture, importer, or UI file. Additional importer suites and UI screenshots do not apply.

**Mutations**

I repeated the two earlier mutations with copied CPS text in `/tmp`. The probes use the post CLI and assert the preamble, operation note, and diagnostics.

- Restore `workOffsetMax = 6`: RED at offsets 7 and 254.
- Emit `G59 P(n - 6)`: RED at offsets 7 and 254.
- Additional regression mutation, restore `workOffsetMax = 255`: RED because offset 255 loses its refusal diagnostic.
- Original and restored copies: GREEN. Offsets 1 through 6, 7, 8, 54, 100, and 254 post without warnings. Offsets 255, 256, 0, -1, and 2.5 produce diagnostics.

No PR source file was changed for these probes.

**Goldens moved**

None. The PR changes no recorded `.nc`, `.cl`, catalog program, or golden file. The existing Mach3 goldens pass unchanged.

**Heavy lanes**

The dry-run plan reaches `app heavy: probe_no_coolant`. It was not run. Current upstream AGENTS.md reserves full heavy lanes for the cut. This P6 PR requires the quick, catalog, and light results above.

**Review state**

The previous blocker is fixed on this new head. Replace the older `needs-rework` label with `merge-ready`. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`. No NeoTech change request applies to this head. This feature follows the release-cut merge rule.

`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is unset on this host. The review job identity is `review-4289-2`; the host is `egg`, and the authenticated login is `mkinney`.

All builds and tests ran locally in the foreground. No GitHub runner was used. The review worktree and branch remain to keep the build warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
